title: Representations of group algebras k[G]
fidelity_note: The book claims a representation of the group algebra A = k[G] is "the same thing" as a representation of G, i.e. a vector space V with a group homomorphism rho : G -> GL(V). Formalized as two genuine bijections (Equiv), replacing the prior vacuous tautology Module k[G] V -> Module k[G] V. repEquivAlgHom: Representation k G V is equiv to (k[G] -> _a[k] Module.End k V), i.e. a representation of G is the same data as an algebra homomorphism out of k[G] (= a k-compatible k[G]-module structure on V). repEquivGL: Representation k G V is equiv to (G ->* (V ~=_l[k] V)), i.e. the same data as a group homomorphism rho : G -> GL(V) into the general linear group of invertible linear maps; invertibility is automatic because G is a group. Characterizing simp/rfl lemmas (repEquivAlgHom_apply_single, repEquivGL_apply, repEquivGL_symm_apply) pin down that the bijections are the intended maps (rho g acts as rho g), not arbitrary relabellings.

title: End_A(A) = A^op
Infinite dimensional Schur lemma (Dixmier)
fidelity_note: [fidelity] Verified faithful (#7243). Countability hypothesis is genuine (hcard : Module.rank ℂ V ≤ Cardinal.aleph0), NOT FiniteDimensional — the statement is strictly more general than finite Schur and non-vacuous. Irreducibility is [IsSimpleModule A V]. Conclusion asserts a genuine scalar operator (∃ c : ℂ, ∀ v, φ v = c • v) for φ : V →ₗ[A] V (A-linear homomorphism of representations), not merely commutation nor a weak existential. Ground field is ℂ literally: the transcendence/uncountability argument (Cardinal.mk_complex, aleph0_lt_continuum) is load-bearing. Axiom-clean: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], no sorryAx.
coverage_note: Formalized (#5884) in Chapter2/Problem2_3_18.lean as Etingof.Problem_2_3_18: for a ℂ-algebra A and an irreducible A-module V with Module.rank ℂ V ≤ ℵ₀, every φ : V →ₗ[A] V is scalar (∃ c, ∀ v, φ v = c • v). Proof follows Etingof's hint: D = Module.End A V is a division ring (Module.End.instDivisionRing / Schur); D is countably dimensional via injective ℂ-linear evaluation D → V at a nonzero vector; a non-scalar φ is transcendental over ℂ (else minpoly has degree 1 since ℂ is algebraically closed and D is a domain); the field ℂ(φ) is realized as the double centralizer Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (Set.centralizer {φ}) (a commutative division subring, hence IsField.toField), inside which Transcendental.linearIndependent_sub_inv gives the uncountable ℂ-linearly independent family {(φ-a)⁻¹}, transported to D along the injective inclusion; then 𝔠 = #ℂ ≤ rank ℂ D ≤ ℵ₀ contradicts ℵ₀ < 𝔠. #print axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.

title: Section 9.5: Blocks
